messages.subject: peakPick fails
parts:
Dear Kylie, 

recenlty, I've been coming accross errors while using Cardinal. There are two types of errors:


1. insteadkurtosis could not be estimated; try method = 'mad' insteadkurtosis could not be estimated; try method = 'mad'
this error appears when I am trying to do peakPicking using the default method "simple". I am working with MSImagingExperiment data class. Even if I am switching the method to "mad", it doesn't help. Strangely enough, despite the fact that I receive endless lines of this error message, peakPicking seems to go on, and may even finish.

2. package "stats" may not be available
OR
standard deviation is zero

I receive multiple running lines of these messages as clustering algorithms (skm and ssc) work. 


Do you have any idea of why I might be encounthering these errors? The datasets are okay for sure, I have used and processed them before.
